task_spec: SUBJECT: let build-playlist take three new kinds of input - a CSV (with a downloadable header-only template), an M3U/M3U8 playlist file, and a folder whose audio files become the playlist in name order - by giving every input format one common seam: an ordered list of candidate EntryRecords that the existing resolution, refusal, synthesis and splice path consume unchanged.

scope: traktor_nml/tracklist.py and traktor_nml/buildplaylist.py (the seam and the parsers), a nicegui-free input-format module under traktor_nml/, traktor_nml/diskscan.py (indexing an explicit ordered list of files), traktor_nml/commands/build_playlist_cmd.py (CLI parity), traktor_nml/gui/app.py's /build-playlist page and traktor_nml/gui/file_picker.py (a save dialog), traktor_nml/gui/theme.py, design/build-playlist/Specs.dc.html, tests/, docs/
out-of-scope: adding new ENTRY elements to the collection for files it does not hold (user decided: report them as unmatched, build-playlist stays a playlist tool)
out-of-scope: recursive folder walks and tag-track-number ordering (user decided: this folder only, name order)
out-of-scope: the /reconnect and / (reconstruct) routes; accessibility and keyboard work (DL-197)
constraints: MUST: traktor_nml/README.md is the decision-log authority; its high-water mark is DL-273, so new entries start at DL-274

MUST: DL-069 nicegui boundary - only app.py, file_picker.py, __main__.py import nicegui; every parser, the template's bytes and every decision rule live in nicegui-free modules the suite reaches; every CSS rule, class and dimension lives in theme.py
MUST: DL-071 - a screen disagreeing with the artboard is fixed in the design first; design/build-playlist/Specs.dc.html is the only build-playlist artboard

MUST: DL-084 as amended by DL-169 - a milestone changing a screen closes on a served-page record in docs/ with a verdict row per surface and structural verdicts, its verdict-row digest registered in tests/test_docs_browser_record_structure.py
MUST: the existing plain-text track-list path produces byte-identical output after the seam refactor, proven against a recorded baseline
MUST: DL-027 - an unresolved entry refuses the run unless allow_unmatched; DL-036 - zero resolved refuses; the unresolved report keeps its columns (line_number, raw_text, artist, title, kind)
MUST: every guard proven to FAIL FIRST with its specific mutation and VERBATIM observed output in its docstring; DL-189 - beware a guard green in exactly the broken state
MUST: app.py is 100% CRLF and must stay so (write with newline=''); theme.py and tests/ are LF; docs/CLAUDE.md and tests/CLAUDE.md are CRLF
MUST: plurals through traktor_nml/gui/wording.plural (tests/test_gui_wording.py forbids an inline `x if n == 1 else y` under gui/); DL-215 - a sentence naming a count reads it off the model
MUST: documentation describes the code as it stands - no 'previously', 'now does', 'no longer', 'added'; never cite a source for something it does not say, line numbers included

MUST-NOT: regenerate tests/baselines/manifest.json or fixture/w002gatefix2; restore a file with git checkout (copy aside and restore from the copy); write into build/ or dist/; install anything into the system interpreter; spawn background agents
MUST: run the suite with C:\Users\marcu\AppData\Local\Python\pythoncore-3.14-64\python.exe, not .venv (.venv has nicegui for running the app)
MUST-NOT: edit matching.py or confidence.py - tracklist.py's module docstring states they are imported and called, never edited or wrapped
entry_points: traktor_nml/tracklist.py:parse_tracklist - text -> (ParsedLine, UnparseableLine); the text format's parser
traktor_nml/tracklist.py:tracklist_record - builds the EntryRecord a line matches as, blanking every field but artist/title, which confines matching to the artist_title tier; this is the seam
traktor_nml/tracklist.py:resolve_tracklist - builds the collection index once at MatchConfidence.LOOSE, match_records per candidate
traktor_nml/buildplaylist.py:assemble_output - takes tracklist_text: str today; must take candidates instead

traktor_nml/matching.py:_CASCADE - tiers audio_id, artist_title_size_time, artist_title_file, file_size_time, artist_title_album_time, path_suffix_3/2, artist_title, path_suffix_1, bare_name_in_folder, filename, bare_name

traktor_nml/diskscan.py:_enumerate_candidates - always rglob-recursive over scan roots, sorted by plain path order; index_scan_roots builds full EntryRecords (tags via mutagen, filesize KB, playtime, bitrate)
traktor_nml/gui/app.py:_run_build_playlist (~1658) and _build_build_playlist_page (~1737) - reads tracklist bytes, decodes utf-8-sig, drives buildplaylist core
traktor_nml/gui/file_picker.py:pick_file_or_folder - native pywebview create_file_dialog, LocalFilePicker fallback when not native; no save dialog exists yet
rejected_alternatives: adding collection ENTRYs for files not in the collection - user chose report-as-unmatched
recursive folder walk, or ordering by tag track number - user chose this folder only, sorted by name
CSV with Artist and Title only - user chose Artist and Title required plus optional Album, Duration, File name, so rows can match on stronger tiers
an example row in the CSV template - left in by accident it becomes an unmatched row that refuses the run; header-only, guidance on screen
ui.download in the native window - pywebview blocks browser downloads by default; native mode uses a save dialog
a plain string sort for folder order - misorders unpadded track numbers ('10 - ...' before '2 - ...'); numeric-aware sort matches Explorer and Finder
current_understanding: Every input today reduces to artist + title. tracklist_record blanks filesize, playtime_float, album, file_name and location, so only the LOOSE artist_title tier can fire - the reason text lists produce ambiguous rows.

A file on disk or an M3U entry carries path, size, duration and tags, which feed stronger tiers the cascade already has (path_suffix_3 at strict, artist_title_size_time, file_size_time, artist_title_file). Reconnect already builds disk-side EntryRecords through diskscan and matching.py already converts disk bytes to Traktor's KB.

EntryRecord.primary_key is location.primary_key = volume + dir_value + file_name (model.py:29-30). An exact-location match for a disk file needs the collection's VOLUME naming, which volumes.py handles.
The GUI's /build-playlist route (commit c8348bf) drives buildplaylist.py's core directly, not the CLI handler.
The user's collections span machines: MacBook-authored collections under D:\Sync. An M3U made on the Mac names /Users/... paths that do not exist on this PC.
assumptions: M3U entries whose file does not exist on this machine must still be matchable from the path string (path suffix tiers) plus #EXTINF artist/title/duration, without reading the file (H - follows from the user's cross-machine setup; verify tier behaviour with an empty filesize)
match_records with a disk-or-file candidate as the OLD side and the collection as NEW counts ambiguity the same way reconnect's opposite direction does (M - must be verified before relying on it)

a folder that holds the same track twice, or a collection holding one file in two locations, may make an entry ambiguous even when its exact path is in the collection; an exact-location pre-pass would fix it but depends on volume naming (M - verify and decide)
Excel CSVs in non-US locales use ';' separators; whether to sniff or refuse is undecided (M - planning decision)
.m3u8 is UTF-8; .m3u is UTF-8 with cp1252 fallback; CSV is UTF-8-sig with cp1252 fallback, and the run says which encoding it used (H - convention)
the unresolved report's line_number means the entry's position for CSV/M3U/folder, raw_text the row, M3U line or file path (H)
invisible_knowledge: The value of file-based input is not a new syntax but stronger evidence: path, size and duration let a candidate match on tiers a text line can never reach. A plan that parses M3U down to artist/title throws that away.
The template's header and the CSV parser's accepted columns must come from one definition, or a downloaded template can stop being uploadable.
Build-playlist references existing collection entries only; it never adds ENTRY elements.

A partial candidate list is indistinguishable from a complete one by inspection (diskscan.ScanCancelled's docstring) - a folder or M3U read that stops early must fail loudly, not return fewer candidates.
Byte-for-byte parity of the text path is the proof the seam refactor changed nothing; without it, a refactor that shifts line numbering or ordering would pass unit tests.
